transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I've been struggling a lot lately with feeling constantly restless and fidgety, and it's starting to really impact my daily life. I've also noticed I'm making a lot of careless mistakes and having a hard time staying focused. It just feels like I can't sit still or keep my mind on one thing.
Do you also often act impulsively, like interrupting others, blurting out answers, or having trouble waiting your turn?
Yes, I definitely struggle with blurting out answers before people even finish their questions. I'm not really sure about the other things you mentioned, but that one happens to me all the time.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were the three ADHD presentations. The patient now endorses both inattentive symptoms (careless mistakes, difficulty sustaining focus) and hyperactive/impulsive symptoms (restlessness, fidgeting, blurting out answers). This makes Predominantly Inattentive and Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive presentations less likely, leaving ADHD Combined Presentation as the best fit.
